description: The Earth Goat in Chinese astrology: personality, Earth element traits, 1979 and 2039 dates and compatibility.
answer: In Chinese astrology, the Earth Goat is the Goat born in a Earth year, one of five versions of the eighth animal. It combines the Goat's gentleness with Earth's qualities. Earth Goat years between 1924 and 2044 are 1979 and 2039. The Goat's fixed element is Earth.

sections.heading: The Earth Goat personality
paragraphs: The Earth Goat is the version where stem and animal share an element, because the Goat's fixed element is Earth. Traditional readings describe this as the Goat at its most stable and practical, with gentleness supported by common sense. Earth Goats are often portrayed as reliable, caring and quietly hardworking, with a strong attachment to family and home. They tend to be patient, thoughtful and good with resources. The doubled Earth gives them steadiness that some Goats lack. It can also bring heaviness, with worry and caution making them slow to embrace change, and they may cling to comfort or routine long after it has stopped serving them. Home, for them, is a lifelong creative project.

In classical thought, Earth belongs to the centre and to the late-summer pause between seasons, the point where things ripen and settle. As a year stem, it tends to slow an animal down in a useful way, adding prudence, loyalty and a strong sense of responsibility. People born under an Earth stem are often described as dependable, sensible and protective of the people they love. They value security and tend to build carefully. The caution traditionally attached to Earth is caution itself: overthinking, clinging to the familiar and carrying other people's problems as though they were their own.

sections.heading: Earth Goat at work and in love
paragraphs: At work, Earth is usually associated with management, organisation and long-term stewardship. Earth-year people are often described as the steady hands who keep systems running, look after budgets and notice when colleagues are struggling, which suits administration, property, finance, agriculture, healthcare and operations. They tend to earn trust slowly and keep it. The traditional caution is resistance to change: an Earth stem may hold on to a process after it has stopped working, so regular reviews and a willingness to experiment help.

Grounded and caring, the Earth Goat tends to be regarded as the most dependable Goat in the workplace. Administration, social care, catering, horticulture and craft businesses are frequently suggested, because patience and attention to others' needs keep those settings running. It likes routines, kind colleagues and visible thanks for its effort, and it rarely complains about the unglamorous jobs. At home the Earth Goat is loyal, nurturing and practical, usually the one making sure everyone has eaten and the spare room is ready. Security matters to it, and so does a partner who notices quiet effort. Friction comes from worry: it may fret about money or the future and need more reassurance than a partner expects.

sections.heading: Earth Goat years and dates
paragraphs: Between 1924 and 2044 the Earth Goat years are 1979 (January 28, 1979 to February 15, 1980) and 2039 (January 24, 2039 to February 11, 2040). Because the year begins at Lunar New Year, a birthday in January or early February needs checking: in 1979 anyone born before Jan 28 is a Earth Horse, not a Earth Goat. The combination returns every sixty years, since five elements cycle through twelve animals and only meet the same pairing again after five rounds of the zodiac. Every Earth Goat year is Yin, matching the Goat's own polarity.

Chinese almanacs call the combination Ji-Wei, joining the heavenly stem Ji to the earthly branch Wei. Births just before each new year fall in the Earth Horse year (before January 28, 1979) and the Earth Horse year (before January 24, 2039), and births in the weeks after each Earth Goat year ends belong to the Metal Monkey. The new year itself fell on a Sunday in 1979 and Monday in 2039.

sections.heading: Growth edges and compatibility for the Earth Goat
paragraphs: For an Earth Goat, gentle movement keeps doubled Earth from settling into stagnation. Small changes, such as new routines, places or people, help them stay open. Because they worry, sharing concerns with trusted friends prevents fears from growing in silence. Earth Goats often enjoy practical creativity, such as cooking, crafts or home-making, which suits both sides of their nature. They may also benefit from setting goals that stretch them a little beyond comfort. Accepting help, rather than shouldering every responsibility alone, eases their load. With openness, Earth Goats become steady, nurturing anchors for those they love.

For relationships, the classical structures belong to the animal rather than the element, so the Earth Goat shares the Goat's San He trine with the Rabbit and Pig (the Wood trine), its Liu He bond with the Horse, and its Liu Chong clash with the Ox. The element adds a second layer: another Earth sign shares this year element, while partners whose year element feeds Earth in the generating cycle are often described as supportive.

faq.question: What years are Earth Goat years?
faq.answer: Between 1924 and 2044: 1979 (from January 28, 1979) and 2039 (from January 24, 2039). Each lasts until the day before the next Lunar New Year.

faq.question: What is the Earth Goat's element relationship?
faq.answer: The year element is Earth and the Goat's fixed element is Earth; in the five-element cycles earth year element matches the fixed element. Readings use that relationship to describe how easily the two sides of the sign sit together.

faq.question: Which animals are most compatible with the Earth Goat?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Rabbit and Pig (San He) and the Horse (Liu He). The Ox is the Liu Chong clash. These pairings depend on the animal, whatever the element.

faq.question: What is the Earth Goat called in the Chinese calendar?
faq.answer: Ji-Wei. In almanacs and Four Pillars charts each year is named by its heavenly stem, here the Earth stem Ji, followed by its earthly branch, here Wei for the Goat, so the name pins down both halves of the combination at once.

faq.question: How is the Earth Goat different from other Goats?
faq.answer: All Goats share gentleness, creativity and empathy. The Earth year element changes the tone: earth sits at the centre of the five-element wheel, and an Earth year is traditionally said to give any animal steadiness, patience and a practical turn of mind.
